differences.name: Desert Mounted Corps War Memorial
differences.reason: Rules 1-3: Wikivoyage Albany names it with 'good views from this point' and Visit Albany's Mount Clarence Heritage & Granite Trail is built around it; the Port Said monument, shipped to Albany in 1959 and standing on Mount Clarence, is a landmark, not a minor plaque. Objection: it could be folded into a Mount Clarence / Albany Heritage Park spot.

differences.name: Old Post Office, Albany
differences.reason: For: Wikivoyage names the 1869 building with its spiral tower stair. Against: one counted source, and it now houses restaurants (the museum's current status is unconfirmed), so a visitor may only see a heritage facade or a dining room (rule 2: a heritage building qualifies only if the public can go in or it is a named stop of a guide's walking route).
